scripts.test: npm run precheck && sh -c 'case "$1" in @*) tag="$1"; shift; mocha --grep "(^| )${tag}( |$)" "$@" ;; *) mocha "$@" ;; esac' --
scripts.generate-spec: npm exec -- redocly bundle specs/controller/openapi.yml --dereferenced --output specs/controller/openapi-fully.yml
scripts.generate-schema-types: rm -rf AcceptanceTests/Api/Types && npm exec -- json2ts -i 'specs/controller/schemas/*.yaml' -o AcceptanceTests/Api/Types/
scripts.spec: npm run generate-spec && npm run generate-schema-types
